<!-- Worth opening before writing code, if the change is more than small. It
is a short conversation that saves you building something that does not fit,
and you will get an answer either way quickly. -->

## The problem

<!-- What you were trying to do and could not. Describe the situation, not the
solution - a well-described problem often has a better answer than the one
either of us thought of first. -->


## What you have in mind

<!-- Your suggestion, if you have one. It is fine not to. -->


## What you tried instead

<!-- Workarounds, other tools, doing it by hand. This tells the maintainer how
much the gap actually costs. -->


## Fit

<!-- Two things this project is deliberate about. Say how your idea sits with
them, if it touches either. -->

- [ ] Works on free tiers, or degrades cleanly without a paid one
- [ ] Does not weaken sourcing — no unverified claim or invented citation
      reaching a video

## Would you like to build it?

- [ ] Yes, if the approach is agreed
- [ ] I would rather just suggest it
